guistrings.dmg.tooltip: Item damage is used to determine item durability, e.g. the damage of a sword. Some mods may use it to determine the "amount" of an item on a simplified level.
guistrings.tag.tooltip: Tag data is the detailed information added to an item. This could be upgrades, enchantments, or the type/amount of fluid in a tank.
guistrings.inventory.direction.*.tooltip: Which "side" of the inventory to operate on. Some blocks have multiple inventories which are accessed via specific sides.
guistrings.npc.repack.tooltip: Put the NPC back into item form.
guistrings.npc.togglefollow.tooltip: Sneak + right-click on an NPC for a shortcut to toggle follow
guistrings.npc.custom_equipment.tooltip: Make the entity spawn with the custom equipment instead of the defaults (otherwise the defaults override the equipments).
